title: research: CCID desync state is permanent with no reset API
description: When an IN transfer fails after a successful OUT transfer, wp11_ccid_ctx_t sets desync=1 and all future wp11_ccid_apdu() calls return WP11_CCID_ERR_USB immediately. Callers cannot distinguish transient from permanent errors, cannot reset the context, and cannot issue an Abort command (CCID INS 0x21) to recover. Research: (1) how does PKCS#11 layer handle repeated WP11_CCID_ERR_USB -- does it remove the slot or spin? (2) Is wp11_ccid_reset() worth adding, or is close+reopen sufficient?
